evidence.description: USB descriptor contains UTF-16LE string 'W55FA93 USB Card Reader 1.00' and vendor string 'Nuvoton' at 0x00475140, uniquely identifying controller vendor

CP15 instructions (mrc p15,0,pc,c7,c14,3 for cache drain, mrc p15,0,rx,c1,c0,0 for SCTLR read) prove ARM926EJ-S / ARMv5TEJ core. ARM/Thumb interworking stubs and vector layout match N32903 series (Ghidra analysis)
GPIO register writes to GPBFUN @ 0xB0000084 match published multiplexer layout. Hardware probing confirmed GPB[2-5] on pins 125-128 matching N32903U5DN LQFP-128 pinout.
No SDRAM initialization routine in BOOT.bin or APP.bin. All RAM references within 8KB SRAM at 0xFF000000, confirming K5DN 'no external SDRAM' variant (firmware-wide analysis)
N32903 architecture, memory map, and peripheral specifications
MMIO fingerprint: Clock/power registers at 0xB0000204/208/18/14, GPIO mux at 0xB000008C/84, doorbell at 0xB800C000, display controller at 0xB100D000
